correctness.rationale: PASS. For k>=3 final-time balls have lengths 2k-1,2k-3,...,1 totaling k^2; perfect-square coverage forces a circular disjoint tiling, leaving every source slide invalid. At n=k^2-1 there is exactly one duplicated endpoint and no triple overlaps; center distances ensure strict ignition. For fixed cyclic time-label order there are n*k states (choose defect interface and rotation), exactly two valid nearest-neighbor slides transferring the single overlap to neighboring arc interfaces. Clockwise defect transport moves each arc once per k steps, and after n such rounds winds through all n*k states, establishing one cycle per order, hence (k-1)! copies. k=2 checked separately. Independently enumerated all ordered tuples and legal neighbor slides for k=2,3,4: square 4,18,96 isolates; one-short 6,48,360 states in respectively 1,2,6 cycles, all degree 2.
